dialog.editDescription: Edit the role's details and permissions.
dialog.duplicateDescription: The permissions and colour have been copied. Adjust the name and confirm to create the new role.
dialog.createDescription: Set the name and permissions of the new role.

delete.title: Delete role
delete.description: The role “{name}” will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

blocked.title: Cannot delete
blocked.description: The role {name} is still used by {count, plural, one {# user} other {# users}}. Reassign them to another role from the Users page, then come back here to delete the role.

pages.title: Accessible pages
pages.subtitle: Controls the visibility of the left-hand menu and access to routes. Unticked pages return a 403.

actions.title: Administrative actions
actions.subtitle: Create / Edit / Delete buttons on list pages and other global actions. These permissions are independent of the planning scope.

scope.title: Display scope and planning control
scope.subtitle: Defines what the user sees and can edit on the planning and all derived views (task list, project list, drop-downs). The first 3 groups are mutually exclusive — one choice per group.

home.label: Home
home.description: Access the home page and personal dashboard.

planning.label: Schedule
planning.description: Access the planning view (Gantt). What is visible on the planning depends on the scope defined in the “Planning scope” block.

tasks.label: Task list
tasks.description: Access the page that lists all tasks in a table.

projects.label: Projects
projects.description: Access the projects page and its sub-sections (project groups, task statuses).

teams.label: Teams
teams.description: Access the list of teams and their members.

business_units.label: Business units
business_units.description: Access the business units page and their addresses.

qualifications.label: Qualifications
qualifications.description: Access the page of qualifications (forklift licence, first aid, etc.) assigned to users.

vehicle_types.label: Vehicle types
vehicle_types.description: Access the list of vehicle types (van, lorry, aerial platform...).

resources.label: Resources
resources.description: Access the list of equipment resources.

resource_types.label: Resource types
resource_types.description: Access the list of resource types.

labor_types.label: Labour types
labor_types.description: Access the list of labour types and their hourly rates.

places.label: Places
places.description: Access the list of places (addresses reusable in tasks).

holidays.label: Public holidays
holidays.description: Access the list of public holidays and import them from Nager.Date.

files.label: File management
files.description: Access the page that lists all files uploaded to tasks.

audit.label: Audit & history
audit.description: Access the audit log, system logs and task history.

stats_projects.label: Project statistics
stats_projects.description: Access project activity and progress statistics.

stats_roi.label: Project ROI
stats_roi.description: Access the project ROI (return on investment) page.

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: Access the application's general settings page.

roles.label: Roles
roles.description: Access the list of roles and their permissions.

backups.label: Backups
backups.description: Access the backup history in the settings.

create.label: Create projects
create.description: Create new projects from the Projects page or the task form.

edit.label: Edit projects
edit.description: Edit the details of visible projects (name, colour, dates, owner...). Limited to the project scope in block 3.

delete.label: Delete projects
delete.description: Permanently delete projects and their tasks.

edit.label: Manage project groups
edit.description: Create, edit and delete project groups.

edit.label: Manage task statuses
edit.description: Create, edit and delete the statuses used to classify tasks.

edit.label: Edit user profiles
edit.description: Edit the details of visible users (name, email, qualifications, team...). Limited to the user scope in block 3.

edit.label: Manage teams
edit.description: Create, edit and delete teams and reorganise their members.

edit.label: Edit business units
edit.description: Edit the details of existing business units (name, address, colour...).

edit.label: Manage qualifications
edit.description: Create, edit and delete the qualifications that can be assigned to users.

edit.label: Manage resource types
edit.description: Create, edit and delete resource types.

edit.label: Manage labour types
edit.description: Create, edit and delete labour types and their rates.

edit.label: Manage places
edit.description: Create, edit and delete places (addresses reusable in tasks).

edit.label: Manage public holidays
edit.description: Create, edit, delete and import public holidays from Nager.Date.

view.label: View files
view.description: View the files attached to tasks in the planning and on the files page.

purge.label: Purge files
purge.description: Permanently purge orphaned or outdated files from the database.

restore.label: Restore from the audit log
restore.description: Restore an entity (task, project, etc.) to an earlier state using the audit log.

purge.label: Purge the audit log
purge.description: Permanently delete audit log entries older than a given date.

use.label: Use exports
use.description: Export planning data to Excel, PDF, CSV or iCal.

edit.label: Edit settings
edit.description: Edit the application's general settings (branding, email, SMS, cache...).

edit.label: Edit roles
edit.description: Edit existing roles and their permissions.

delete.label: Delete roles
delete.description: Delete custom roles (system roles cannot be deleted).

bypass.label: Bypass maintenance mode
bypass.description: Access the planning even when maintenance mode is enabled globally.

view.label: Receive notifications
view.description: Receive notifications through the header bell and the real-time feed.

use.label: Use the MCP connector
use.description: Allow an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT...) to read planning data through the MCP connector.

write.label: Allow MCP writes
write.description: Allow the MCP connector to create, edit or delete data (in addition to reading).

use.label: Use the AI assistant
use.description: Access the AI chat (Assistant page and floating bubble). The assistant reads the planning with the user's own permissions.

write.label: Allow changes by the AI assistant
write.description: The assistant can offer to create, edit, move, duplicate or delete tasks and projects. Every change always requires the user's explicit confirmation. Requires “Use the AI assistant”.

projects_all.label: All projects
projects_all.description: See the tasks of every project on the planning, without restriction.

projects_bu.label: Projects in their business unit
projects_bu.description: See only the tasks of projects that belong to their own business unit.

projects_team.label: Projects of their team
projects_team.description: See only the tasks of projects owned by a member of their team.

projects_own.label: Projects they take part in
projects_own.description: See only the tasks of projects they own or take part in through an assigned task.

projects_assigned_only.label: Tasks assigned to them
projects_assigned_only.description: See only the tasks assigned directly to them, regardless of the project.

users_all.label: All users
users_all.description: See the rows of every user on the planning.

users_bu.label: Users in their business unit
users_bu.description: See only the users who belong to their own business unit.

users_team.label: Users in their team
users_team.description: See only the members of their team on the planning.

users_self.label: Only themselves
users_self.description: See only their own row on the planning.

modify_readonly.label: Read only
modify_readonly.description: No changes are possible on the planning. Actions such as moving, resizing, creating or deleting tasks are disabled, whatever actions are ticked below.

modify_all.label: Edit everything
modify_all.description: Can edit every visible task, with no restriction other than visibility.

modify_team.label: Their team's tasks
modify_team.description: Can edit only the tasks assigned to a member of their team.

modify_own_project.label: Tasks of their projects
modify_own_project.description: Can edit only the tasks that belong to projects they own.

modify_own.label: Their own tasks
modify_own.description: Can edit only their own assigned tasks or the ones they created.

bu_all.label: All business units
bu_all.description: The user can select any business unit in the global selector and see the data of every business unit.

bu_own.label: Their own business unit only
bu_own.description: The user only sees the data of their own business unit. The global selector is disabled.

view_calendar.label: Personal calendar
view_calendar.description: Allows access to the “Personal calendar” view, which shows the signed-in user's tasks in a daily calendar layout.

view_team_day.label: Team / day view
view_team_day.description: Allows access to the “Team/day” view, which shows the team's tasks hour by hour over a single day.

view_vehicles.label: Vehicles view
view_vehicles.description: Allows access to the “Vehicles” view, which shows the vehicle allocation planning.

view_resources.label: Resources view
view_resources.description: Allows access to the “Resources” view, which shows the equipment resource allocation planning.

create.label: Create tasks
create.description: Can create new tasks. Target users and projects are limited to the scope defined above.

delete.label: Delete tasks
delete.description: Can delete existing tasks, within the limits of their editing level.

assign.label: Assign users
assign.description: Can add or remove users on a task. Target users are limited to the user scope.

move.label: Move tasks
move.description: Can move tasks by drag and drop on the planning (change the date or the assigned user).

resize.label: Resize tasks
resize.description: Can resize the duration of tasks by dragging their right edge on the planning.

lock.label: Lock tasks
lock.description: Can lock and unlock tasks to prevent accidental changes.

errors.cannotRenameSuperAdmin: The Super Administrator role cannot be renamed
errors.cannotEditSuperAdminPermissions: The permissions of the Super Administrator role cannot be changed
errors.cannotDeleteSystem: A system role cannot be deleted
errors.hasUsers: This role cannot be deleted: {count, plural, one {# user is still assigned to it} other {# users are still assigned to it}}. Reassign them to another role and try again.
